1. Sign in to Microsoft Defender multitenant management
2. Select Add tenants.
3. Choose the tenants you want to manage and select Add
The features available in multitenant management now appear on the navigation bar
and you're ready to view and manage security data across all your tenants.

７ Note
The Microsoft Defender multitenant view currently has a limit of 100 target tenants.

